QUOTE: Without a callback, unlisted tools are denied. With one, every call passes approval. Deny-list entries still block at `execute`, but only after the callback has already reported the call.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says unlisted tools are denied when no callback exists and pass when a callback is set. It never concludes that default-allow is the effective posture at the blocking gate for tools on neither list.
